name: asella-organic
description: Asella Organic — MySQL-backed e-commerce/inventory system. Monorepo with backend/, frontend/, and Playwright E2E tests at the root.

scripts.dev: sh -c '[ -f frontend/dist/index.html ] || npm run build --workspace=frontend; PORT=3000 exec npm run dev --workspace=backend'
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend
